title.narrative: Connecting the dots: Linking economic, gender and climate justice to tackle global challenges

description.narrative: Contract related to: Connecting the dots: Linking economic, gender and climate justice to tackle global challenges - The Development Education and Awareness Raising (DEAR) Programme contributes to the geopolitical objectives of the Commission, building the support of EU citizens, particularly youth, for sustainable development and cooperation with partner countries. It aims at changing behaviour, notably by promoting solidarity and encouraging active citizenship engagement for the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), showing EU people¿s determination to act for the global collective interest.The present Action, under the CSO Thematic Programme 2021-2027, proposes to implement the DEAR Programme through five (5) actions.The largest part (85%) of the funding under this Action Document will flow to the Call for Proposals in the area of DEAR (Action 1). The remaining 15% are used for ¿flanking measures¿ to finance targeted projects (Actions 2 ¿5)to improve policy environment in the area of DEAR in Europe, facilitate exchanges and build multi-stakeholders approach to development education and awareness raising in Europe.
